archive.scope: Extends existing Odin module: number/note/multiuse title parsing, START, sequential non-jumping cursor, route lookahead, collected filtering and editable HUD. Missing archive RouteSteps helper independently replaced.

Independent compatible local UUID list, /sl add/remove/list/importlegacy, bounded opt-in Mojang lookup, PF local warning and opt-in delayed kick. No upstream code copied. Original /sl parse and short aliases not ported.
Manual F7/M7 P3 solver, pre-update flashes, click guard, progress and break/restart alerts. Triggerbot/Auto Start/custom WAV/title/format not ported.
Periodic bounded stand/mob correlation, native glow and nearest tracer; validates changed name/exact policy.
Pets-menu snapshots, unique-identity cache, total JSON XP and changed-snapshot rates, active highlight, summon/Autopet tracking and title. Live curve/progress, loadout hook and all polish not ported.
Exact CRIT+marker signature, four observations, bounded evidence, 20-tick TTL, Galatea guard.
Three-skull textures, loaded scan, fills/lines/labels and three particle patterns. Auto Black Hole not ported.
Cone fill, opaque rim/spokes, rainbow and first-person/depth options; native triangles.
Three nested torus shells, shimmer, bob, rainbow, disc. Native unculled triangles; no framebuffer bloom.
Native hotbar translation/scale and optional native item-name/info/XP followers. Custom skins/vertical layout/selection animation not ported.
